name: 061-video-r1
prompt: Traditional hand-drawn Japanese gothic 2D anime. Maintain clean black ink contours, matte skin, two flat shadow values and broad painted shapes throughout, no realistic 3D texture. Kimi stands upright on both boots in front of the cross, knees extended, full body and both boots inside frame at ALL times. NO crouch, NO kneeling. She brings both crescent blades forward, pale C-blade in her anatomical LEFT hand and dark C-blade in her RIGHT hand, and an opaque indigo protective ward closes around her: the ward begins WIDE and OPEN, then contracts into a closed dome shape in a single smooth continuous motion. The dome surface stays opaque and solid indigo, never transparent or glassy. One thin amber magic projectile arrives from the foreground and strikes the OUTSIDE of the closed dome with a brief sharp flash; the projectile does not pass through and Kimi is not hit. After impact the ward holds steady. Bound orange-haired Claude and her cross remain behind Kimi, fully visible and unchanged. Camera holds a wide shot, does not cut, does not orbit. End with the ward closed and intact. No new characters, no text.
